commands.name: dashboard-suite
commands.run:
out=$(bash claude/skills/todos/scripts/tests/todos_dashboard_test.sh 2>&1); rc=$?; printf '%s
' "$out" | tail -1; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || exit 1; printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -q ' 0 failed$' || exit 1; for l in 'render: fixture board' 'research: index' 'slug: default path and repo slug' 'read-only: state root and .todos untouched' 'empty: board without .todos' 'flags: completed and usage errors' 'offline: precedence' 'guard: output path' 'write: failed write preserves the previous page' 'unreadable: todo skipped' 'refs: self, invalid, and unreadable dependencies' 'links: boundaries' 'visibility: .todos exclusion warning' 'inject: frontmatter values never become attributes' 'symlink guard: output path through a symlink into .todos' 'opener: missing opener is a warning' 'records: empty, null, and stale record shapes' 'frontmatter: first occurrence wins'; do printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -qF "ok   $l" || { printf '[X] missing check: %s
' "$l"; exit 1; }; done

commands.name: dashboard-suite-size
commands.run:
out=$(bash claude/skills/todos/scripts/tests/todos_dashboard_test.sh 2>&1); rc=$?; last=$(printf '%s
' "$out" | tail -1); printf '%s
' "$last"; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || { echo '[X] suite exited non-zero'; exit 1; }; printf '%s
' "$last" | awk '{ exit !(NF == 4 && $1 >= 115 && $2 == "passed," && $3 == 0 && $4 == "failed") }'

commands.name: todos-suite-baseline
commands.run:
out=$(bash claude/skills/todos/scripts/tests/todos_test.sh 2>&1); rc=$?; last=$(printf '%s
' "$out" | tail -1); printf '%s
' "$last"; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || { echo '[X] todos suite exited non-zero'; exit 1; }; printf '%s
' "$last" | awk '{ exit !(NF == 4 && $1 >= 162 && $2 == "passed," && $3 == 0 && $4 == "failed") }'

commands.name: render-smoke
commands.run:
set -e; here=$(pwd); d=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT; sd=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$d" "$sd"' EXIT; (cd "$d" && git init -q && git config user.email t@t && git config user.name t && git commit -q --allow-empty -m base && git update-ref refs/remotes/origin/main HEAD && git remote add origin git@github.com:Org/Repo.git && printf '.todos/
' >>.git/info/exclude); mkdir -p "$d/.todos/pending"; printf -- '---
created: 2026-05-01
title: A
---
' >"$d/.todos/pending/2026-05-01-a.md"; printf -- '---
created: 2026-05-02
title: B
depends_on:
  - todo:2026-05-01-a
---
' >"$d/.todos/pending/2026-05-02-b.md"; out=$(cd "$d" && TODOS_STATE_ROOT="$sd" TODOS_DASHBOARD_NOW='2026-05-03 00:00' bash "$here/claude/skills/todos/scripts/todos.sh" dashboard --out "$d/o/x.html"); [ "$out" = "$d/o/x.html" ] || { echo "[X] stdout: $out"; exit 1; }; f="$d/o/x.html"; grep -q 'data-todo="2026-05-02-b" data-state="blocked"' "$f" || { echo '[X] no blocked row'; exit 1; }; grep -q 'todo:2026-05-01-a (open)' "$f" || { echo '[X] no dep state'; exit 1; }; grep -q 'data-count="open">2<' "$f" || { echo '[X] open count'; exit 1; }; grep -q 'data-count="blocked">1<' "$f" || { echo '[X] blocked count'; exit 1; }; if grep -qiE '<script|<link|<iframe|@import|url\(|fonts\.googleapis| on[a-z]+="' "$f"; then echo '[X] script, remote asset, or event attribute in page'; exit 1; fi; [ -z "$(ls -A "$sd")" ] || { echo '[X] state root written'; exit 1; }; [ ! -e "$d/.todos/TODO.md" ] || { echo '[X] TODO.md written'; exit 1; }

commands.name: stdlib-only
commands.run: python3 -c "import ast,sys;t=ast.parse(open('claude/skills/todos/scripts/todos_dashboard.py').read());names=set();[names.update(a.name.split('.')[0] for a in n.names) for n in ast.walk(t) if isinstance(n,ast.Import)];[names.add((n.module or '').split('.')[0]) for n in ast.walk(t) if isinstance(n,ast.ImportFrom)];bad=sorted(x for x in names if x not in sys.stdlib_module_names);print('imports:',sorted(names));[print('[X] non-stdlib import:',x) for x in bad];sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)"

commands.name: dispatch-thin
commands.run: base=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD) || exit 1; added=$(git diff "$base" -- claude/skills/todos/scripts/todos.sh | grep -c '^+[^+]'); removed=$(git diff "$base" -- claude/skills/todos/scripts/todos.sh | grep -c '^-[^-]'); printf 'todos.sh +%s -%s\n' "$added" "$removed"; [ "$added" -ge 1 ] && [ "$added" -le 2 ] && [ "$removed" -eq 0 ] || { echo '[X] todos.sh diff is not a thin dispatch'; exit 1; }; grep -q '^    dashboard) exec python3 ' claude/skills/todos/scripts/todos.sh || { echo '[X] no dashboard case'; exit 1; }; git diff --quiet "$base" -- claude/skills/todos/scripts/tests/todos_test.sh || { echo '[X] todos_test.sh changed'; exit 1; }

commands.name: skill-doc-pins
commands.run: for s in 'todos.sh dashboard' '--completed' '.todos/research/' 'kind:' 'artifact:' 'task:' 'TODOS_DASHBOARD_DIR' 'TODOS_STATE_ROOT' 'todos.sh init' 'review-findings'; do grep -qF -- "$s" claude/skills/todos/SKILL.md || { printf '[X] SKILL.md missing: %s\n' "$s"; exit 1; }; done

commands.name: orch-preflight-line
commands.run: base=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD) || exit 1; f=claude/skills/herdr-orchestration/SKILL.md; added=$(git diff "$base" -- "$f" | grep -c '^+[^+]'); removed=$(git diff "$base" -- "$f" | grep -c '^-[^-]'); printf 'orch skill +%s -%s\n' "$added" "$removed"; [ "$added" -eq 1 ] && [ "$removed" -eq 0 ] || { echo '[X] preflight change is not exactly one added line'; exit 1; }; git diff "$base" -- "$f" | grep '^+[^+]' | grep -q 'todos.sh dashboard' || { echo '[X] added line does not name todos.sh dashboard'; exit 1; }; awk '/^## 1\. Preflight/{p=1} /^## 2\./{p=0} p' "$f" | grep -q 'todos.sh dashboard' || { echo '[X] line is not in section 1'; exit 1; }

commands.name: suite-registered
commands.run: bash bin/dotfiles-tests --list | grep -qx 'bash claude/skills/todos/scripts/tests/todos_dashboard_test.sh' || { echo '[X] suite not registered in bin/dotfiles-tests'; exit 1; }

commands.name: diff-scope
commands.run: base=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD) || exit 1; changed=$(git diff --name-only "$base" -- . ':(exclude)docs' ':(exclude)claude/contracts/td-2026-09-06-render-a-local-dashboard-of-open-todos-and-researc-contract.json'); printf '%s\n' "$changed"; [ -n "$changed" ] || { echo '[X] no implementation changes'; exit 1; }; for f in $changed; do case "$f" in claude/skills/todos/scripts/todos.sh|claude/skills/todos/scripts/todos_dashboard.py|claude/skills/todos/scripts/tests/todos_dashboard_test.sh|claude/skills/todos/SKILL.md|claude/skills/herdr-orchestration/SKILL.md|bin/dotfiles-tests) ;; *) printf '[X] out of scope: %s\n' "$f"; exit 1 ;; esac; done

commands.name: ascii-added-lines
commands.run: base=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD) || exit 1; git diff "$base" -- . ':(exclude)docs' ':(exclude)claude/contracts' | python3 -c "import sys;bad=[l for l in sys.stdin.buffer.read().split(b'\n') if l.startswith(b'+') and not l.startswith(b'+++') and any(b>127 for b in l)];[print('[X] non-ascii added line:',l[:80]) for l in bad];sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)"

commands.name: no-attribution-in-added-lines
commands.run: base=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD) || exit 1; if git diff "$base" -- . ':(exclude)docs' ':(exclude)claude/contracts' | grep '^+' | grep -v '^+++' | grep -iE 'co-authored-by|generated (by|with)'; then echo '[X] attribution text in added lines'; exit 1; fi; exit 0
